description: crosscheck probing itself: a scanner that analyzed nothing must never be credited as having run.

controls.name: sast-not-credited-without-analysis
controls.declares: cc ci --require-sast must not report CLEAN when zizmor/actionlint exit without analyzing, even though the audited repo owns their config files

refused_when.output_contains: no Actions SAST produced an analysis

controls.name: clean-repo-still-passes
controls.declares: the control must not over-block: a genuinely clean, fully-pinned repo still returns CLEAN under --require-sast
